b: Just as the title says really. My boyfriend broke up with me completely out of the blue and it’s shattered me. I’ve been in a long term relationship before this but i ended things and was relieved to be rid of my ex. This time round I was so in love with him, didn’t want it to end at all. This feels like my first real heartbreak. I’ve felt sick for days, not eating or sleeping.

We were together for 18 months. At the start of the relationship he did warn me he’d need to take things slow, he was badly betrayed by his ex wife (she had a long standing affair with someone else, and is still with the affair partner now) so he has some internal emotional issues and lots of walls up. This didn’t scare me and we took things slowly.

What continued was the most wonderful relationship I’ve ever had. He treated me with so much kindness and respect, remembered the little things about me, small gestures when I was poorly/feeling down. We really connected and just ‘got’ each other. We went on multiple getaways abroad and made some really special memories.

throughout all of this time he never said ‘I love you’ which my friends all thought was weird but knowing his past I didn’t. And the way he acted towards me showed me he definitely had very deep feelings. I thought I understood him.

Anyway things have still been good and I’ve been really happy. And then last week when I saw him like I usually would, this massive can of worms opened about all of his doubts and feelings about us. He’s not ready for me to meet his kids, he doesn’t give me enough time (because he has his kids for half the week), I deserve better, I bring so much energy to the relationship that he can’t match, he’s struggling to understand his feelings and doesn’t know if he’ll ever get to the point of loving me, he needs to spend more time focusing on his job and his kids, he has his own standards of how he wants to be a partner and he’s not able to do that because of how busy life is with his work and kids. Apparently his friends and family have been asking him if he loves me, and when he’s going to introduce me to the kids and it made him realise he’s not ready for any of that.

This completely blindsided me. An avoidant discard. He’d already made his mind up. We spent a few days apart to think things through. When we met back up he was still saying all of the same things. I embarrassingly tried convincing and begging him, telling him all of the way we could still make this work but he couldn’t agree with me. I told him I loved him.

Leaving his house was really hard, we both got really upset as I was putting my shoes on. He then confused me by saying how wonderful I am, all of the positive ways I’ve impacted him and all of my positive qualities. Reassured me it’s nothing to with me, but him. Said he’s really going to miss me, and if we’re meant to be together then he trusts the universe will bring us back together.

How do I even begin to get over this? I really thought he was my person. I’ve been nothing but patient, kind, considerate and loving towards him. We never argued once, I always uplifted him and told him what an amazing partner he was. His ending statement of trusting the universe has messed with me because all I can think about it the fact he’s going to reach out in 6 months when he’s healed but I know that’s not necessarily the case. And it’s not healthy for me to ruminate on that.

I didn’t know it was possible to cry this much, or to eat/sleep so little. Please give me your best advice to get over this. And also any positive stories of moving on and realising it was for the best? I’ve never felt so down.
